resources.string: Drag on the table to aim. The dotted line shows where the cue ball goes and where the first ball it hits will roll.
Set the power with the slider and use the spin pad for follow, draw or side english, then press Shoot.
8-ball: sink all your solids (1 to 7) or stripes (9 to 15), then the 8. 9-ball: always hit the lowest ball first and sink the 9 to win.
Scratching, hitting the wrong ball first or sending nothing to a cushion is a foul: your opponent gets ball in hand.
Pocket a ball legally to keep shooting. Tap Hint for a suggested shot.
Chalk on a cue tip adds friction so the tip does not slip off the ball. Players chalk before almost every shot.
